# Transition XII: The Tools We Hand Down

## The Age of Prodigies

The years between 2015 and 2025 were, for many Americans, a time of political fracture and technological acceleration in equal measure. The internet had completed its transformation from wonder to weapon. Social media had reshaped how people understood truth, community, and their own attention.
